    Our Custom Leather Jackets In THE PRESS

    Our custom leather jackets have earned recognition from respected editors & independent publications. From leading fashion magazines to niche style blogs, our craftsmanship, attention to detail, and ability to personalize each jacket have been consistently highlighted. The industry continues to notice us for all the right reasons: exceptional quality, flexibility, and custom leather jackets that speak for themselves.

    Custom Leather Jackets  For Brands, Teams & Businesses

    We make custom leather jackets with logos for brands, teams, and businesses, built for real-world use and consistent branding. You pick the jacket style, color, and fit, then we apply your artwork exactly where you want it, like chest, sleeve, or back. For customization, we offer custom patches of different types. woven, leather, or chenille and custom embroidery for logos, names, team marks, and brand icons. Whether you need a clean, minimal logo or a more detailed design, we help you choose the best method for durability and clarity. You can start small with no minimum requirements to test a sample, or scale up with bulk orders for launches, uniforms, and gifting programs. These jackets are a strong fit for events, company gifts for clients, employee rewards, team wear, and VIP kits.

    Leather Types

    Every custom leather jacket begins with our finest leathers. Our core proposition is the finest quality leather that ranges from lambskin, sheepskin, and goatskin to buffalo hide and cowhide. Choose full grain for lasting durability, suede or nubuck for soft texture, or sheepskin and shearling for natural warmth. For unique looks, tie and dye, matte, glossy, or textured finishes add character, while aniline and semi-aniline highlight the natural grain. All leathers for your custom leather jackets are hand-selected to ensure quality, comfort, and style.

    Customization Options

    Personalization makes your jacket one of a kind. Add embroidery or patches for a statement piece, create a custom embroidered leather jacket with your name or logo, or use printing for bold graphics. Hardware can be tailored in antique brass, silver, or gunmetal, while quilting and studwork offer additional design freedom. Whether subtle or expressive, your jacket will be tailored to you.

     Lining Materials

    Inside, your jacket is just as customizable as the outside. Inner lining material options include satin for a smooth feel, viscose or cupro for breathable comfort, cotton for everyday wear, taffeta for structure, or fur and sherpa for colder climates. Each lining is selected to match the function and personality of your custom leather jacket. Materials available on request as well.

    How The Jackets Are Made?

    Our Bespoke Process

    Our custom leather jackets are crafted with precision through a detailed process that ensures your vision comes to life perfectly.

    01. Digital illustration

     Our design team begins your journey by creating a digital mockup of custom leather jackets, capturing every detail of your vision for approval before moving into production.

    02. Pattern making

     Once approved, concepts are translated into precise patterns, providing a technical foundation for crafting custom leather jackets that balance style, fit, and function while staying true to your design.

    03. Sourcing Leather

     We source the exact hide you’ve chosen, ensuring the finest quality leather or suede. Every custom leather jacket begins with carefully selected materials that define both its character and durability.

    04. Cutting & Construction

     Experienced craftsmen cut panels with accuracy and stitch them together, combining traditional expertise with modern techniques to create custom leather jackets that embody both strength and individuality.

    05.Personalization Touches

     Embroidery, logos, patches, hardware, and unique details are added with precision, ensuring your custom leather jacket reflects your story and personal expression in every crafted element.

    06. Finishing & QC

    Each jacket undergoes finishing treatments and rigorous quality checks. Only custom leather jackets that meet our highest standards of craftsmanship, durability, and comfort are approved for delivery.

    From Mock to Reality

    Your completed custom leather jacket is photographed and shared for final approval, celebrating the journey from initial concept to a tangible, one-of-a-kind creation made just for you.

    FAQ: Answered

    Do you offer XXL & above sizes?

     Yes! Our men’s apparel is available in sizes XS-4XL, and women’s apparel in sizes XXS-3XL. We also offer custom sizing ( made-to-measure) for all products.

    Do you offer shipping to individuals for bulk orders?

     Yes, we can ship directly to recipients in different locations. Your design consultant will guide you through where it's possible and the incurring charges 

    Can you ship internationally?

     Yes, we offer free international shipping, with shipping costs included in the product's per-unit price.

    What is your return policy?

    Customized items are non-returnable. For bulk orders, we recommend sampling to ensure satisfaction with quality and sizing. Individual custom bomber jackets can be returned for alterations under our custom order policy.

    What are your payment terms?

     We require advance payment, with the option for installments. Full payment is due before shipping.

    What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?

     We have no MOQ. Whether you need a single unit or a bulk order, we’ve got you covered.

    What is the average turnaround time?

     Custom orders typically ship in 12 weeks, with expedited options available based on order complexity.

    Do I qualify for a discount?

     Your design consultant will ensure you receive the best pricing and available discounts, especially for bulk orders.

    Can I see a sample of my jacket before confirming?

    We don’t offer free samples for one-unit orders, but you’ll receive a visual mockup and photoshoot before dispatch. For bulk orders, a free sample may be available, guided by your design consultant.

    What if I have additional questions?

    Our design consultant is available via email and will respond within 24 hours. Call support is also available for order-related inquiries.

    Can a leather jacket be tailored?

    Tailoring is available. We can adjust the fit to your measurements, including jacket length, sleeves, shoulders, and overall shape. Design details like pockets, hardware, lining, and finishes can also be customized.

    Do you add logos and branding?

    Logos and branding can be added through embroidery, patches, labels, and other placement options, depending on your design and durability needs. We have produced for both small businesses and large organizations.

    What customization options are available?

    Most elements can be customized, including style, fit, leather type and color, lining, hardware, pockets, zippers, collars, cuffs, sizing, and branding placement.

    Do you make jackets for men and women?

    Jackets are available for men and women, and unisex fits can be made based on your preferences.

    Can I order embroidered jackets?

    Embroidery is available, from simple logos to detailed artwork, based on placement, material, and design complexity.

    Are patches available?

    Patches are available in woven, leather, and chenille options. Patch orders typically start at 50 pieces.

    Do you make jackets for businesses or teams?

    Programs are available for companies, teams, and event groups, including bulk orders and repeat runs to keep branding consistent for new team members.

    Can I design my own jacket?

    Your own design can be created. Share references, sketches, or inspiration, and we will turn them into clear mockups for approval before production.

    What makes your jackets high-quality?

    Our quality comes from premium materials & finest leather, strong craftsmanship, careful stitching, and reliable quality control, backed by experience across a wide range of custom orders.

    Do you offer painted jackets?

    Painted designs are available. Share your concept, and we will confirm the best placement, finish, and durability approach.

    Can I add embroidery to an existing design?

    Embroidery can be added to many designs. If a placement is not suitable for direct stitching, a patch-based approach may be recommended.

    Are tailored jackets different from standard sizes?

    Tailored jackets are made to your measurements for a more precise fit, while standard sizes follow a general size chart.
